sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def snap(fr):
    a=fr.ascii.split('\n'); d={}
    for i in range(10,63):
        for j in range(64):
            ch=a[i][j]
            if ch not in ('B','W'): d[(i,j)]=ch
    return d
before=snap(current_frame)
# find magenta ball
mag=[k for k,v in before.items() if v=='M']
print("ball M pixels",sorted(mag))
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':41,'col':16}])
after=snap(current_frame)
added={k:v for k,v in after.items() if before.get(k)!=v}
removed={k:v for k,v in before.items() if after.get(k)!=v}
print("added",added)
print("removed",removed)
mag2=[k for k,v in after.items() if v=='M']
print("ball M now",sorted(mag2))
print("done",last_action_result.get('level_completed'),last_action_result.get('done'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
